name: The Happiness of Hakari
source:
Despite her prestigious magical parents, Hakari has never known how to do magic. That sure doesn't stop her from being cursed! To protect Hakari, her home and the inhabitants within, all are sealed off from the rest of the world.  What will happen during this magical house arrest...?

[From [url=https://kirigen.itch.io/the-happiness-of-hakari]itch.io[/url]]
